subject.title: [Bug]: 2026.7.1 — Codex plugin fails: "does not provide an export named 'formatToolExecutionErrorMessage'" in agent-harness-runtime

question: After verifying the published 2026.7.1 tarballs and Docker image, should this compatibility repair be shipped as an immediate stable hotfix or only in the next normal release?
rationale: The report affects the current stable release and manual artifact patching is the only reported recovery, so release timing and coordinated core/plugin publication require an explicit owner decision.

options.title: Verify and hotfix
options.body: Reproduce from published 2026.7.1 artifacts, repair the package graph and compatibility checks, then publish aligned core and official-plugin packages promptly.

options.title: Next release only
options.body: Land the artifact and test repair on main but defer publication to the next scheduled stable release with documented temporary recovery guidance.

recommendation.title: Verify and hotfix
recommendation.body: Reproduce from published 2026.7.1 artifacts, repair the package graph and compatibility checks, then publish aligned core and official-plugin packages promptly.
